svg.text: Cost vs. availability under scaled fault rates (50 RSMs, 2000-VM catalogue)
Exact Monte Carlo per-RSM availability (region/AZ outages on); budget-targeted fleet ILP vs. random-menu ILP and fixed-RF baselines
Numbers beside baseline markers are the replication factor (3/5/7). Budgets: 10-100% of the random-menu ILP's unrestricted cost.
